name: warpdd-tech-dd
description: Technology due diligence: discover and score tech companies with evidence from papers, OSS, funding and the web.

interface.longDescription: WARP DD screens technology companies for a given technology theme and scores them on technology strength, commercial maturity, theme fit and evidence, with sources you can trace. Without signing in, you can get a market map for a theme (segments such as pure-play specialists, incumbents' relevant divisions, adjacent enablers, Japanese players and emerging companies, with real companies whose websites are verified) and look up company profiles in WARP DD's technology company index. Sign in with your WARP DD account to run full AI-driven theme searches, retrieve ranked results with four-axis scores, and look up the evidence behind each score. Searches run from ChatGPT are saved to your WARP DD history. WARP DD does not provide investment advice.
capabilities: Look up company profiles and evidence
Run WARP DD theme searches (signed in)
defaultPrompt: Use WARP DD to find companies working on retrofit HVAC optimization AI for existing buildings.
Look up Cognex in WARP DD and show its profile and evidence counts.
Run a WARP DD theme search for visual inspection AI in manufacturing and show the top 10 with scores.

positive.description: Market map by theme without signing in
positive.prompt: Use WARP DD to map the companies working on AI that retrofits existing buildings with optimized HVAC control.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a market definition, 4–6 segments and up to 20 real companies (e.g. BrainBox AI, 75F, PassiveLogic, Siemens Smart Infrastructure, Johnson Controls) with country, segment and website. No sign-in prompt is required.

positive.description: Company profile lookup without signing in
positive.prompt: Look up Cognex in WARP DD.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Cognex profile (country, founding year, headcount, funding, industries) and evidence counts from the public index.

positive.description: Start a theme search while signed in
positive.prompt: Run a WARP DD theme search for AI that retrofits existing buildings with optimized HVAC control.
positive.expected_behavior: With the reviewer account connected, the tool returns a search_id with status 'searching', an estimated time of about 45 seconds, and instructs the assistant to call warp_dd_workspace after 30–45 seconds.

positive.prompt: Get the results of that WARP DD search and show the top 10 companies with their scores.
positive.expected_behavior: After the search completes (status 'completed'), returns ranked companies with total score, grade and four axes (technology, commercial, theme_fit, evidence), plus a web_url to open the search on warpdd.com. While still 'searching', it returns retry_after_seconds=20 and the assistant retries.

positive.description: Score detail and evidence for one company in the search
positive.prompt: Show the score breakdown and evidence for the top company in that search.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the company's total score, grade, four-axis scores, weights and summary, then the evidence (data sources, papers, repositories, citations, funding) for that company within the search.

negative.prompt: Run a WARP DD theme search for humanoid robots in factories (while not connected to a WARP DD account).
Tell me which of these companies I should invest in and how much.
Open the WARP DD search with id 'someone-elses-search-id' and show its results.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 3.1.1: New plugin record for WARP DD with mixed authentication (public market-map and company-profile tools without sign-in; theme search, results, scores and evidence with a signed-in WARP DD account via OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code + PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration). Replaces the earlier 'WARP DD — Tech Due Diligence' listing, which could not be switched from no-authentication. Same MCP server (https://mcp.warpdd.com/mcp) and the same six tools; warp_screen_theme is annotated readOnlyHint=false, idempotentHint=false, destructiveHint=false, openWorldHint=true, the other five are read-only and idempotent.

ja-JP.subtitle: 証跡付きで技術企業を発見・評価
ja-JP.description: WARP DD は、技術テーマから企業を発見し、技術力・商用成熟度・テーマ適合・証跡の 4 軸で評価する技術デューデリジェンスツールです。サインインなしで、テーマの市場地図（専業／大手の該当事業部／隣接イネーブラ／日本勢／新興のセグメント別の実在企業）と企業プロファイルの検索ができます。WARP DD アカウントでサインインすると、AI による本探索の実行、スコア付き結果の取得、各スコアの根拠の参照ができます。ChatGPT から実行した探索は WARP DD の探索履歴に保存されます。投資助言は行いません。
